title: Chapter 114 Ace Team Wiped Out
content:
Chapter 114 Ace Team Wiped Out

Members of the cavalry team began to head to the center of the explosion to search for Wang Shuo's traces.

Although no one believed that Wang Shuo was still alive.

But holding a little fantasy is better than being hopeless.

Then, more people began to take action.

They began to look for their lord everywhere.

At this time, Duan Wenxi checked his friend list.

He found that Wang Shuo's avatar had not disappeared!

He shouted excitedly: "Boss, he is not dead yet, he is still alive!!!"

After hearing this, other people were greatly encouraged and tried harder to find him.

...

Wang Shuo just felt dizzy.

He couldn't figure out where he was now.

[You are dead, but the system detects that the player has resurrection coins and automatically resurrects. ]

[You can choose to resurrect on the spot, or teleport to resurrect randomly. ]

"Resurrect on the spot."

His consciousness gradually became able to feel the surrounding environment.

There was a cloud of smoke in front of him, comparable to thick fog.

The air was filled with the smell of burnt meat, which was very pungent.

"Ahem, ahem."

"I heard the voice of the Lord."

Li Weiguo shouted excitedly.

"Really? Where?" Hearing this, Gong Zheng walked over quickly.

"It's inside." Li Weiguo pointed to the front, in the smoke with extremely low visibility.

"Let's go in and look for it."

"Let's go!"

"Lord?"

The people shouted loudly.

After Wang Shuo heard this, he was very happy. At least many of his people survived.

"I'm here..."

Gong Zheng smiled. As a tool man, this was incredible.

Perhaps because of the increase in level and attributes, his emotions gradually became richer.

Soon, Gong Zheng found Wang Shuo and carried him out.

When everyone saw Wang Shuo, countless cheers rang out.

"Lord, it's really great that you're still alive."

"Long live the Lord!"

"Long live Wana Village!"

"Yeah, we won!"

...

Seeing the excited expressions of the people.

Wang Shuo was also very happy, with a feeling of surviving a disaster.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded.

[You led your subjects to win the "Defend Wana Village" mission after a hard-fought battle. ]

[Award the title of "Outstanding People and Beautiful Land" for Wana Village's territory attribute, effect: all subjects' qualification levels are increased by 1 level, permanently effective; reward the village's popularity by 100. ]

[Award "Wall Construction Technical Manual" +1, "Light Catapult Construction Drawing" +1]

[Because you commanded properly in the defensive battle, you will be rewarded with command +10. ]

[Award reputation +800]

[You killed the level 30 gold boss, Toad (ID: Frog00001 Brunei)]

[Your level is increased to level 24. ]

[Because you are the first player to kill the gold boss, you will be rewarded with all attributes +5 and marrow cleansing pill +1. 】

[Reward reputation +300]

[Your subordinates..., performed well in this battle, reward...]

...

A series of prompt sounds made Wang Shuo a little overwhelmed.

At the same time, all the people in the territory also received system prompts at the same time.

Everyone showed an incredible expression on their faces.

In an instant, they smiled, and then laughed out loud!

"My qualifications have been upgraded by 1 level, and I have also learned a skill called 'Precision'."

"I have opened the command attribute and gained command +2. I can lead troops!"

"I have a reputation, and I actually gained 100 points of reputation,..."

Wang Shuo was also very happy for everyone when he saw the rewards of everyone.

He turned to look at Ayub and the others, and asked happily: "How are you?"

Ayub replied: "I have +10 command, +10 strength, +200 reputation."

Gong Zheng: "I have +10 defense, +10 constitution, +10 command, +300 reputation, and I also learned a skill on my own, Taishan pressure."

Ayub turned to look at Gong Zheng, and he inexplicably felt a sense of comparison.

This made him feel incredible.
